title: Go has only for
hints: Go has a single looping keyword, for, which covers three-part loops, condition-only ("while") loops and infinite loops.
A Go for clause has no parentheses: for i := 0; i < n; i++ { … }. A while loop is just `for condition { … }`.
Write `for n > 0 {` in CountDown, and remove the parentheses around the clause in SumTo.
